company.name: Vezeeta
company.shortDescription: Vezeeta provides patients with a digital healthcare booking platform and management software.
company.description:
Vezeeta is the digital healthcare platform in MEA that connects patients with healthcare providers and health services. 

Patients are able to search, compare, book, and review the best doctors in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and Lebanon. It also provides innovative SaaS solutions to healthcare providers in the region. Vezeeta empowers millions of patients through data and the ability to better access healthcare in the region. With over 200,000 verified reviews, patients are able to search, compare, and book the best doctors in just 1 minute. Doctors also provide Patients with seamless healthcare experiences through our clinic management software.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform that enables patients to search for doctors, view available appointment times, and book medical consultations either in clinics, hospitals, at home, or via telemedicine.
productsAndServices.name: Vezeeta Digital Healthcare Booking Platform

productsAndServices.description: A software solution designed to help clinics and healthcare providers manage appointments, patient records, and clinic operations digitally.
productsAndServices.name: Vezeeta Clinic and Practice Management Software

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows patients to order medications online through the Vezeeta platform and have them delivered from partner pharmacies.
productsAndServices.name: Vezeeta Pharmacy Ordering and Delivery Service

productsAndServices.description: A subscription-based service offering users discounts on medical consultations, diagnostic services, clinic visits, surgeries, and pharmacy supplies within the Vezeeta network.
productsAndServices.name: Vezeeta Subscription Service 'Shamel'

productsAndServices.description: Loyalty programs that reward users with points for pharmacy purchases and physical activity, which can be redeemed for discounts on future orders.
productsAndServices.name: Vezeeta Loyalty Programs (Vezeeta Care and Move & Earn)
